title: Claude Code: Build & Debug Your Code Instantly! #shorts
description:
Career changers learning to code, ever hit a wall with a stubborn bug? I was stuck for hours until I gave Claude access to my codebase. Watch how it diagnosed and fixed the issue in minutes. You won't believe the results. Catch the full Easier Said Than Done Podcast on YouTube Or Spotify.
GET THE LINKS HERE:   https://meetzubin.carrd.co #CareerChange #softwareengineer #coder
transcript: Now you can use Claude code in the terminal to actually build that code out for you or discuss with you what the specs should be, what the product requirements are, what the design thinking around the actual software would be. Or you're in the middle of coding and there's some weird bug and you just can't figure it out. It's like a pair programming. You just give Claude access to that code base and say, "Hey, you know, there's a bug here. This is the bug. This is the result. This is the stack trace. This is what I'm expecting. This is what I'm actually getting. This test is failing." Whatever information you have that you'd normally use as a developer to try and troubleshoot a bug, you'd give it a Claude, give it all that context, and set it loose in your code base, and it will, nine times out of 10, at least if not more, fix it.
